name: Microsoft 365 Education
hint: An app registration in Microsoft Entra with these application permissions, admin-consented: EduRoster.Read.All, EduAssignments.Read.All, EduAssignments.ReadWriteBasic.All; the roster comes from School Data Sync, and the token address holds your directory ID.

endpoints.name: list_classes
endpoints.description: Lists the first page of the directory’s classes.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: get_class
endpoints.description: Returns one class. Its ID is also the ID of the class’s Microsoft 365 group.

endpoints.name: list_class_members
endpoints.description: Lists a class’s students and teachers.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items
Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: list_class_assignments
endpoints.description: Lists all of a class’s assignments, drafts included. filter takes OData on any property, such as status eq 'assigned'.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: get_assignment
endpoints.description: Returns one assignment. Its status is draft, scheduled, published while it is being handed out, or assigned once students have it.

endpoints.name: list_assignment_submissions
endpoints.description: Lists the submissions to one assignment, one per student once it is published. filter takes OData on any property, such as status eq 'submitted'.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: get_submission
endpoints.description: Returns one student’s submission and its status; the grade and feedback are in its outcomes.

endpoints.name: list_submission_outcomes
endpoints.description: Lists a submission’s grades and feedback: points, feedback and rubric outcomes. Each holds the teacher’s latest value and the one returned to the student, such as points and publishedPoints.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: list_user_classes
endpoints.description: Lists the classes a student or teacher is in. The user ID is their Microsoft Entra user ID.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: list_user_assignments
endpoints.description: Lists a student’s or teacher’s assignments across all their classes. instructions and webUrl are always null here; get the assignment from its class for them.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: list_schools
endpoints.description: Lists the first page of the directory’s schools.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: get_school
endpoints.description: Returns one school, with its address and principal.

endpoints.name: list_school_classes
endpoints.description: Lists the first page of a school’s classes.

endpoints.name: list_school_users
endpoints.description: Lists the first page of a school’s users, each with a primaryRole such as student or teacher.

notes.$top: Show only the first n items

endpoints.name: create_assignment
endpoints.description: Creates a draft assignment in a class; students see it only once it is published. Body: {"displayName", "dueDateTime", "instructions": {"contentType": "text", "content"}, "grading": {"@odata.type": "#microsoft.graph.educationAssignmentPointsGradeType", "maxPoints"}, "assignTo": {"@odata.type": "#microsoft.graph.educationAssignmentClassRecipient"}}, dueDateTime in ISO 8601 UTC.

endpoints.name: publish_assignment
endpoints.description: Publishes a draft assignment: each student it is assigned to sees it and gets a submission. It runs in the background, so get the assignment after; its status turns assigned when done, or back to draft if it failed. Body: {}.
